column3: \tランス城でそれぽい朝の儀式、おとそ、お年玉
column4: A New Year's morning ceremony at Rance Castle: Otoso (spiced sake), New Year's money.

column3: \t各国の首脳陣も集まっている（一応、滅亡の可能性があるのでＩＦ処理で）
column4: The leaders of various countries are gathered (with an IF branch in case of possible destruction).

column3: \t今、戦争中という雰囲気をみじんも見せずにお正月ムード
column4: Even though there's a war going on now, not a hint of it shows-just New Year's mood.

column3: \tたんたんとお正月シーンが続く・・（少し長めでもいい、場違いな雰囲気が大事　）
column4: The New Year's scene continues plainly... (a little longer is fine, the out-of-place atmosphere is important).

column3: \tビスケッタさんが、１０時になりました、時報のようにいいます
column4: Biscuitta-san says, 'It is now 10 o'clock,' like a time signal.

column3: \tすると、みんな立ち上がり、さぁ、お正月はおしまい、仕事、仕事と・・
column4: Then everyone stands up, saying, 'Alright, New Year's is over, work, work...'

column3: \tパキパキと切り替えていく
\tランスが、うむむ・・情緒のわからんやつだ、お正月は３日は仕事したら駄目なんだぞ
column4: Rance says, 'Hmm... What a guy without emotion, you're not supposed to work for the first three days of New Year's.'

column3: \t旦那様、旦那様が決めた事ですよ、こんな非常時だがお正月はする、２時間だけと割り切ってすると
column4: Master, this is what you decided. Even in such an emergency, we do celebrate New Year's, but only for two hours, with a clear limit.

column3: \tうう・・しかしな、やっぱ正月だぞ・・
column4: Ugh... but still, it's New Year's after all...

column3: \tこれが人類にとって最後のお正月になってもいいのでしたらね
column4: If this is to be humanity's last New Year's, then so be it.

column3: \tまた、世界には今も死にかけている人が多数おり、ランスさんが動かないと今もまた・・
column4: Also, there are still many people near death around the world, and if Rance doesn't act, even now...

column3: \t今や世界の命運を握る存在となったこのランスにゆっくりとしたお正月は無かった。
column4: Rance, who now holds the fate of the world in his hands, had no leisurely New Year's.
